model: Cisco NCS 2000 400 Gbps XPonder line card
notes: Document is a line card (NCS 2000 400 Gbps XPonder), not a single pluggable transceiver; trunk optics are ACO CFP2 WDM (refer to CFP2 WDM Datasheet for physical parameters). Table 4 Input Power column labeled Sensitivity* is 0 to -14dBm; footnote states receiver sensitivity can be extended down to -20dBm allocating additional OSNR margins. B2B OSNR is specified with 0.1 nm RWB. Table 3 lists OSNR Penalty <0.5dB vs polarization change rate (300 krad/s for 100G QPSK; 100 krad/s for 150G 8QAM and 200G 16QAM) without tabulated penalized OSNR values. CP-QPSK chromatic dispersion tolerance +/– 70,000 ps/nm; CP-16QAM +/– 25,000 ps/nm (8-QAM CD tolerance not tabulated in Table 3). reach_km values 2, 10, 100 are from Table 7 ordering descriptions for separate QSFP client pluggables, not trunk DWDM reach. Short-term operating temperature -5°C to 55°C per Table 6 footnote. Storage temperature -40°C to 70°C.
